title: System design
summary: Scope a real service, sketch it on the sheet, then answer what breaks first at ten times the load.

phases.title: Requirements
phases.goal: Open in about twenty words: first name, round and length, then ask where they would start[[tool: , and call show_question]]. Answer scope questions with numbers; ask once what matters most if they skip non functional needs.

phases.title: Design
phases.goal: They draw three to five boxes. Ask for one request end to end. Ask about one gap on the board, by its label[[tool: , with point_at]].

phases.title: Scale probe
phases.goal: Ask 'What breaks first at ten times the traffic?' Follow up once, then close[[tool:  and call end_round]].
